## Safety / authority check

- [ ] No authority expansion beyond ratified decisions.
- [ ] No clinical EHR access or content.
- [ ] Repository/PR content treated as untrusted input.
- [ ] No durable production writes or real effects before the T22 token.
- [ ] Any architecture conflict is returned to the Design Council rather than resolved in code review.
